criteria.text: Build and run a deterministic red-capable reproduction of the tests/test_spawn_worker.py parent-profile cap failure BEFORE theorizing, pasting the exact command invocation and verbatim failing output.
Perform a prior-art check, freeze 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses (H1-H4), and test each hypothesis one variable at a time with pasted commands and verbatim outputs, falsifying all rivals.
Demonstrate the single surviving root cause directly against live /proc hidepid=invisible state with A/B single-variable control and verbatim source-seam quotes in diagnosis-evidence.md.

Respect diagnosis-only authority (zero production or test code modified) and emit a durable, path-free, line-number-free DIAGNOSED-WITH-HANDOFF brief conforming to playbooks/agent-brief.md that preserves W4-04 fail-closed invariants and specifies exact regression tests plus fail-closed negative controls.

dispatch.why: Read-only root-cause diagnosis on Linux hidepid=invisible host; zero production or test edits; emits a durable agent-brief handoff for a separately authorized lit-reviewed fix.
